description_en: Creates a custom library to store the entity information for recognition

kebab_example: aliyun ice create-recognition-lib --algorithm landmark --lib-name Landmark_test_library --lib-description For_storing_product_recognition_samples --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRecognitionLib

parameters.help_en:
The type of recognition algorithm. Valid values:

- landmark

- object

- logo

- face

- label

识别类型，取值：

- landmark：自定义地标。

- object：自定义物体。

- logo：自定义logo

- face：自定义人脸

- label：自定义标签
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The name of the recognition library. Max length: 64 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 识别库名称，最长支持 64 字节
parameters.name: lib_name
